registration: Frozen before extended-length cluster pressure predictions. Transfer all 63 cards from the extended local scan, including all 45 new 100 pc--1 Mpc cards and 18 repeated controls. Preserve every development cluster, scenario, comparator and numerical threshold; no local-status filtering or object-specific parameter fits.
population: Exactly the original eight development clusters, same 30 pressure targets and eight unscored boundary points; reserved clusters and new raw data are not read.
source_sensitivity_scope: Wider reconstructions already exceed the primary 2 percent stellar fidelity limit for A85. Retain them as flagged sensitivity probes, never as acceptable fitted source alternatives. Outer closures are unmeasured source assumptions. No winning nuisance scenario is promoted.

pressure_control.scope: Every model, cluster and global scenario. Separately refine source and pressure integration grids. Any unresolved case withholds all pressure scores for that card; never remove an object to obtain admission.

pressure_mapping: Integrate d[Pe/(1-f)]/dr=-mu*mp*ne*g with the same smoothed gas density used in the joint gravitational source; f=fout*r/ranchor. Full radial action variation includes the density-gradient term and both tangential Hessian components. No algebraic proxy for the length-dependent force.
response_interval: From the first eligible target to the unscored measured boundary; retain all measured gas and stellar source knots inside that integration interval. This grid choice uses radii only.
scoring: Same equal-cluster mean squared log10 pressure ratio and three conditional covariance treatments as the preceding cluster study. Matched nuisance comparisons, object influence, symmetric trim and stellar-profile strata. Raw descriptive counts separate from quality-verified and uncertainty-resolved counterexamples.
claim_ceiling: Quality-limited spherical development diagnostic. No family pruning, first-principles derivation, full Solar System pass, galaxy success, lensing or independent validation claim.
